counting_method: Page-aware pdftotext extraction with heading-bounded functional segments, reconciled against the 20-page contact sheet and full-resolution renders for the summary, main equations, decision figures, and Appendix A. PDF page 2 is a title-only page and PDF page 3 is contents; both are excluded from the 18-page technical denominator. Formula rows, captions, table cells, and running headers are not prose paragraphs.
ambiguities: Page fractions are non-additive because indicator construction, model establishment, results, and verification share physical pages.
The paper has no section titled Introduction; Section 1 Problem Statement performs that rhetorical job.
Strengths and Weaknesses appears after each indicator and again after the plan, so the functional strengths-limitations chapter has three disjoint segments.
The main body delegates thirteen fitted relationships to Appendix A; the appendix is therefore part of the model specification rather than supplementary decoration.
Appendix row numbering repeats 3, and the final Jobs expression contains a poorly defined exponent; both are retained and flagged rather than silently normalized.
